a.xlink:title: Executes a halfword data transfer instruction.
Calculates the offset from the base address in a single data transfer instruction.
Returns the index of the Rd register (source/destination register).
Returns the index of the Rn register (base register).
Returns the type of the instruction (see CHalfword_Data_Transfer::NType).
Returns the value of the L bit (Load/Store).
Returns the value of the P bit (pre/post indexing).
Returns the value of the U bit (up/down).
Returns the value of the W bit (write-back).
Performs a halfword data read from a given address.
Performs a halfword data write to a given address.
Performs a shift on the given value.
Performs an ASR (arithmetic shift right) operation on the given integral value.
Performs an LSL (logical shift left) operation on the given integral value.
Performs an LSR (logical shift right) operation on the given integral value.
Performs an ROR (rotate right extended) operation on the given integral value.
Tests whether a bit is set in the given integral variable.
Checks whether the given integral value is negative by examining the MSB.
Reads data from the bus.
Sign-extends the given integral value.
Converts a given virtual address into a physical address using the MMU.
Writes data to the bus.
